events.name: Port Adelaide v Collingwood
events.selectedSentence: Port Adelaide enter 12th and Collingwood 16th; a late-season test of where both clubs finish.
events.fullSpiel: Port Adelaide are 12th with 16 points, while Collingwood are 16th with 4. That makes this more than a date in Round 11: it is a late-season test of where both clubs finish, with the next chapter shaped by the separation they create or erase.
